note: Role tree art, first drafts (23 Nov). The loot sheet's form: name -> box, with frames left to right. Sizes in px at 640x360. See README.md.

challenged.note: Over the head of a Challenged enemy (origin = the top of its head, plus a pixel or two). Drawn WHITE and grey: multiply it by the challenger's scarf colour (Art.PLAYER_COLORS). The dark outline stays dark.

open.note: Over the head of an Open enemy. A guard cut in two on a slant. Every frame reads on its own, so it can be shown for any length of time.

spark.note: The Mender's Spark, lying on the ground: a green square cross. Origin on the ground under it. No outline, no shadow.

spark_fade.note: The same loop hatched: play it in place of spark for its last 2 s.

spark_take.note: Played once when a Spark is walked over.

shimmer_tin.note: Ore Sense: glints over the undug rock of a hidden tin tile. One tile. A slow loop; start each tile on a different frame so they do not blink together.

shimmer_copper.note: The same for copper, in copper's colours and with the glints in other places.

shimmer_chest.note: Ore Sense: a chest hidden in a sealed place or under the ground. A dotted chest outline with a glint on the latch.

emblem_warden.note: Tree emblem for the Warden column head, in the ability glyphs' style.

emblem_striker.note: Tree emblem for the Striker column head, in the ability glyphs' style.

emblem_mender.note: Tree emblem for the Mender column head, in the ability glyphs' style.

emblem_delver.note: Tree emblem for the Delver column head, in the ability glyphs' style.
